shortDescription: Information module for Event Subscription Rest

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: category
options.description: Category query parameter. List of subscriptions related to the respective category.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain query parameter. List of subscriptions related to the respective domain.

options.name: eventIds
options.description: EventIds query parameter. List of subscriptions related to the respective eventIds (Comma separated event ids).

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. The number of Subscriptions's to limit in the resultset whose default value 10.

options.name: name
options.description: Name query parameter. List of subscriptions related to the respective name.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. The number of Subscriptions's to offset in the resultset whose default value 0.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. SortBy field name.

options.name: subDomain
options.description: SubDomain query parameter. List of subscriptions related to the respective sub-domain.

options.name: type
options.description: Type query parameter. List of subscriptions related to the respective type.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
